_readme: Copy to oauth-clients.json (kept out of git). google: a Google Cloud OAuth client of type Desktop app. googleAndroid: a second client in the same project, type Android (package com.jartro.tasks + the signing certificate's SHA-1, Advanced settings → Enable custom URI scheme), for the phone. microsoft: an Entra app registration (Application (client) ID) with a Mobile and desktop platform redirect of http://localhost/oauth2callback, plus an Android platform (package com.jartro.tasks + signature hash) for the phone.
